description: List entries of the BFS PXWeb database tree. Without 'path' lists all STAT-TAB databases (at BFS each is one table, id like 'px-x-1003020000_101', with its title); with 'path' lists that node's children (type level/table, text, updated). Use 'filter' to substring-match titles. Examples: {filter:'Wohnbevölkerung', lang:'de'}, {path:'px-x-0102010000_101'}.

filter.description: Case/diacritic-insensitive substring filter on titles or ids

lang.description: Language of titles/labels: de, fr, it or en (default en)

path.description: Node path, e.g. 'px-x-0102010000_101'. Omit for the root listing.

name: browse_bfs_tables
title: Browse the BFS STAT-TAB table tree
